summary: Project Astro V STEM is an interactive web-based educational and scientific visualization platform developed to explore space science concepts and astronomical data dynamically. We developed a responsive front-end interface utilizing HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, enhanced with custom particle animation engines to simulate cosmic phenomena and make complex astrophysics accessible to students and space enthusiasts. This project addresses the challenge of science communication and STEM engagement by translating raw space data into immersive, browser-rendered visual models. It is important because it bridges the gap between complex space agency data repositories and interactive public learning, fostering the next generation of scientists, engineers, and researchers through intuitive digital tools.
details:
• What it does / How it works: It provides a lightweight, browser-based simulation and visualization tool that renders interactive space-themed environments and data structures using modern JavaScript and custom CSS styling. It runs locally or via web servers using Python scripts (server.py) for seamless execution.
    • Languages: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
    • Backend/Server utilities: Python (server.py).
    • Environment & Dependencies: Configured via requirements.txt.
  • Creativity & Team Considerations: Focused on performance optimization, responsive cross-platform compatibility, and clean modular UI design to ensure accessibility even in low-bandwidth or resource-constrained educational environments.
